tool: p_fit.py --edge, exported to the raw-profile format
note: RAW measured silhouette, L5b's OWN extractor -- ONE instrument over the whole circle, so no seam between two edge finders is baked into the profile. It is a SEPARATE FILE from L1's metrology/outline-raw-oflynn-front.json and neither is merged into the other. Edge position is the 50% crossing of the smoothed luma profile, not the gradient peak, and a candidate counts only if the profile stays bright for 1.5 mm beyond it.
agreement_with_L1: median 0.0158 mm over the 1182 rays both extractors report, p90 0.6378 mm, max 1.6129 mm. Two independent extractors agreeing to 16 um in the median is the cross-check; the tail is where they disagree and it is the problem arcs.

controls.E1_verdict: NOT LOAD-BEARING - the annulus is 5.79 mm wide and the persistence window needs 1.5-3.5 mm of it, so the control span cannot clear both the hole's bright shelf and the rim
